sources.articleTitle: Mother Dairy hikes rate by Rs 2-4 per litre from tomorrow; check prices
Mother Dairy raises milk prices by ₹2-4 per litre, effective November 12

headline: Mother Dairy Implements Milk Price Increase Across Delhi-NCR Region
metaDescription: Mother Dairy has announced a price increase of two to four rupees per litre for its milk products in the Delhi-NCR area, effective November 12, 2026.
aiSummaryBullets: Mother Dairy is increasing milk prices by two to four rupees per litre.
The new pricing structure for the supplier becomes effective on November 12.
This revision follows the company's previous price adjustments in May and April 2026.
aiContextParagraph: Mother Dairy, a prominent milk supplier within the Delhi-NCR region, has officially announced a retail price adjustment for its dairy products. The new rates, which reflect an increase of two to four rupees per litre, are scheduled to take effect on November 12, 2026. This move represents the latest change in the supplier's pricing strategy, following a previous hike implemented on May 14, 2026. Records indicate that prior to the May increase, the company also conducted a price revision in April 2025. These frequent adjustments in retail costs are a component of the company's operational pricing model for consumers in the capital territory and surrounding areas. The announcement has been disseminated by major news outlets, noting the specific timeline for when residents can expect to see the updated figures at retail outlets across the metropolitan region.
whyItIsViral: The story has gained attention due to reporting from two major national outlets reflecting immediate consumer impact on essential goods.
